components.description: Loads and serves the bus program: ide_bus, early answers, the data lane, ide_bus_noiordy. Switches early answers <-> the lane live (bus = auto), holds IORDY while core 1 answers, drives INTRQ. The data lane streams data-in words by DMA, without core 1.

Register values to drive onto DD

components.description: The register table: every register read answered by the PIO from values core 1 keeps ready, for hosts that ignore IORDY.

relationships.description: Register values kept in the table
Register values kept in the table

components.description: Multiword DMA's data phase: hands DD0-15 to its PIO block for a burst, feeds it by a DMA channel, drives DMARQ.
components.name: ide_dma

components.description: The hard disk: task file, status, IDENTIFY (patched live when DMA is added), READ/WRITE SECTORS, MULTIPLE and DMA, read-ahead, write-behind, two units.

components.description: PACKET commands, MMC (READ(10), TOC, GET EVENT), disc changes; hdcd::Device puts it beside the hard disk.

components.description: bus = auto on core 1: applies the DMA patch between commands and switches the program at a quiet moment or while RESET# is held.

components.description: Commands, completions and (on request) every bus access, recorded for core 0 to print. Lock-free SPSC ring.
components.name: Trace ring

components.description: The handshake between the cores: core 1 posts a fetch (LBA, buffer, read or write), core 0 posts the result. Shared memory.
components.name: Fetch mailbox

containers.description: The real-time half. Answers every register access the PIO hands it, runs the ATA/ATAPI command state machines, starts DMA bursts. Never waits: everything it runs per access is in RAM (CORE1_RAM), never touches USB or the card.
containers.name: Core 1: bus loop

components.description: serveFetches(): takes core 1's fetches from the mailbox, reads or writes the block source, holds results for seek timing. Per-sector code in RAM (CORE0_RAM).
components.name: Fetch service
